profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Chime
profile.summary: I am a full-stack web developer with a business background who loves to build awesome things. Some of my favorite tools are Rails, AngularJS, and Node.js. Tinkering is in my DNA. I'm a self-starter who loves to continually learn by solving new and interesting challenges.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built user-facing features for our Dialer product, a VOIP/SMS powered Chrome extension, that
enables users to call and text clients from Gmail, Salesforce, and grooveapp.com.

• Architected and assembled a call recording feature from backend to frontend, that allowed users to record their phone calls. These recordings were automatically logged to Salesforce.

• Contributed to the rebuilding of our Dialer product to use a new state management paradigm. This greatly simplified our state management, making it more stable and robust.

• Fully re-implemented several of our legacy UI’s using React/Redux/Redux-Saga.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and built features using Rails, ReactJS, AngularJS, and Elasticsearch, ranging from
complex B2B dashboards to e-commerce checkout flows.

• Built the product setup wizard for our rentals product. This involved building a user-friendly UI that made it easy for merchants to enter complex business and pricing rules for their rentals.

• Revamped our Elasticsearch implementation to handle new types of products imported from our B2B platform. This included adding geo-search to our product search feature.

• Developed a real-time checkout feature for activities and rentals. This pulled availability and pricing data from our B2B platform and displayed that information in our B2C marketplace.

• Cut average page load time by 50% on our B2C site via caching, better SQL, and fewer assets.

• Led the project to migrate our frontend build to Webpack. We were able to reduce the initial Javascript bundle by 1 MB for our checkout iframe.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked as a full-stack web developer at Bountysource, a funding platform for open-source software. I had the opportunity to build several client-facing features in Rails and AngularJS, while finding ways to increase the robustness of our code base.

• Implemented a Javascript unit testing suite. This involved serving compiled assets to Jasmine and leveraging Require.js to load test fixtures.

• Upgraded the entire frontend application to Bootstrap 3 and Angular 1.2. This involved massive updates to the application to address breaking changes.

• Ported the internal admin site from an in-house Javascript framework to AngularJS

• Designed and built the data model for the Request-for-Proposal feature, which allowed developers to submit work proposals to managers of open source projects

• Built a natural language, type-ahead search using the Sphinx search engine

• Organically sorted open-source issues for GitHub organizations base on their members’ activity, which was pulled from the GitHub events API

• Code reviewed and gave feedback on pull requests from other Bountysource developers

positions.title: Senior Legal Assistant
positions.description:
Sanford Heiser, LLP is a  public-interest law firm that specializes in civil rights and public interest litigation and represents employees with claims of employment discrimination, labor and wage violations, predatory lending, whistleblower, and consumer fraud. I wore many hats at Sanford Heisler.
 
• Scripted data mergers using the R programming language in a successful case against AT&T,       
   saving weeks of manual analysis

• Drafted briefs for active class action cases on behalf of employees in the United States District 
  Court for Northern California

• Lead a team of 4 Legal Assistants and interviewed new hires

positions.title: Policy Intern
positions.description:
This arm of the Treasury Department was set up to create the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, a new regulatory agency whose mission is to make the markets for consumer financial products work for Americans. I performed several roles at the Treasury Department.

• Directly assisted Sen. Elizabeth Warren in her duties as Assistant to President Obama for the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau

• Collaborated with the web development team to develop financial complaint forms

company.name: U.S. Department of Treasury, Office of Consumer Protection, CFPB Implementation Team
